properties.status: PROVISIONAL — DATA ACQUISITION ONLY, NOT A MODELLING REGION
properties.why: Every download script resolves its extent from total_bounds of the ACTIVE domain's region, so only the BBOX matters for data acquisition. This rectangle is a deliberate SUPERSET of any plausible v3 polygon, so the pulls it drives stay valid once the real QGIS polygon replaces it.
properties.replace_with: the user's QGIS v3 polygon — v1.5's drawn northern ring verbatim (Narrows + Arthur Kill cuts), no Manahawkin wall, south to Cape May
properties.never: do NOT build a mesh, probe mesh size, or freeze on this rectangle — it includes open ocean and inland NJ that no v3 polygon will contain
